input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products
input.rationale: Section 6.1 binds the Company (our party) to an exclusivity covenant for the whole term. The term under Section 4.1 is one year but renews automatically each anniversary indefinitely, and the only exit (90 days' notice) triggers a Termination Payment under Section 4.2(a), so the exclusivity effectively runs for the full, open-ended term with no performance-based release; Section 1.6's go-live termination right applies only pre-launch. That fails the fallback, which requires exclusivity capped at 12 months and ending automatically on the Vendor's failure to meet service levels or delivery dates. Because HDI bears all development and hosting costs and gives a reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 (which benefits us and is untouched), we have taken the fallback rather than deleting the covenant: 12 months from the Effective Date, limited to the defined Deerskin Products category, with automatic termination on any HDI service level, availability or delivery failure.

proposal.summary: Limit Company's exclusivity in Section 6.1 to 12 months and add automatic termination on HDI service/delivery failure
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept an exclusivity that binds us for the full, automatically renewing term with no performance-based exit, so we have limited our undertaking in Section 6.1 to the defined Deerskin Products category for twelve months and made it fall away automatically if HDI misses a service level or delivery date. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 and its exclusive brand right during that period are unaffected.

ops.oldText: during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate
ops.newText: during the twelve (12) month period commencing on the Effective Date, the Company shall not participate

ops.oldText: for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
ops.newText: for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet; provided, that the Company's obligations under this Section 6.1, and HDI's exclusive right hereunder, shall terminate automatically and without penalty or Termination Payment upon HDI's failure to meet any service level, availability or delivery date obligation under this Agreement, including Section 1.6.
